nodes.label: Validate Transaction Format
nodes.description: Verify transaction follows EIP-2718 type-2 format with all required fields

nodes.label: Transaction Format Valid

nodes.label: Read Parent Block Values
nodes.description: Extract parent_base_fee, parent_gas_used, parent_gas_target

nodes.label: Parent Values Loaded
nodes.description: All values needed for base fee calculation are available

nodes.label: Compare Gas Used to Target
nodes.description: Determine if parent block was over, under, or at target (50% of limit)

nodes.label: Gas Used at Target
nodes.description: Parent block gas used equals gas target

nodes.label: Gas Used Above Target
nodes.description: Parent block was more than 50% full

nodes.label: Gas Used Below Target
nodes.description: Parent block was less than 50% full

nodes.label: Keep Base Fee Unchanged
nodes.description: Base fee remains same as parent

nodes.label: Increase Base Fee
nodes.description: Calculate delta = max(parent_base_fee * gas_delta / target / 8, 1)

nodes.label: Decrease Base Fee
nodes.description: Calculate delta = parent_base_fee * gas_delta / target / 8

nodes.label: New Base Fee Calculated
nodes.description: Base fee for new block has been determined

ambiguities.text: The specification lacks explicit rules for transaction pool (mempool) behavior and eviction policies for EIP-1559 transactions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume mempool implementations use priority_fee_per_gas for sorting and evict transactions whose max_fee_per_gas falls below projected base fees.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'gas limit changes must stay within ±0.1% of parent block' does not specify whether this is per-block or cumulative.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this is a per-block constraint: each block's gas limit can differ from its parent by at most ±0.1% (actually 1/1024 ≈ 0.098%).

ambiguities.text: The initial base fee of 1 Gwei is specified for the London fork but behavior for new chains or reorgs past London is unclear.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume INITIAL_BASE_FEE = 1 Gwei applies only to the first EIP-1559 block, and subsequent blocks always calculate from parent.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block producers will include transactions honestly based on priority fee rather than engaging in base fee manipulation strategies.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Validators could collude to keep blocks artificially small, preventing base fee from decreasing, extracting more MEV from users.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot sustain blocks that are consistently 100% full (2x target) for extended periods without significant cost.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Sustained full blocks would cause base fee to increase by ~12.5% per block, potentially reaching extreme levels and causing network instability.

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallet software and user interfaces will correctly implement max_fee_per_gas and max_priority_fee_per_gas estimation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may overpay significantly if max_fee is set too high, or have transactions stuck if set too low during fee spikes.

implicit_assumptions.description: The deflationary pressure from burning base fees will not cause economic instability or hoarding behavior.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: ETH could become overly deflationary during high-usage periods, potentially destabilizing the economic model.
